subject.title: [Bug]: Control UI header logo/icon not displaying after 2026.3.24 update

question: Should OpenClaw support Control UI public assets under browser-inferred legacy or arbitrary route prefixes when no `gateway.controlUi.basePath` is configured?
rationale: Current source intentionally supports root, configured basePath, and `/__openclaw__/`, while tests still preserve 404s for arbitrary prefixed static assets; changing that is a URL-contract and static-serving policy choice.

options.title: Support inferred prefixes
options.body: Treat route-prefix hard refreshes such as `/openclaw/skills/workshop` and legacy nested URLs as supported, then land a narrow allowlisted public-asset fix.

options.title: Limit to documented mounts
options.body: Keep support to root, configured basePath, and `/__openclaw__/`, then close this issue and the stale linked fork PR with the documented URL contract.

options.title: Support only named legacy paths
options.body: Add explicit compatibility for known retired Control UI prefixes such as old `/connections` routes without general arbitrary-prefix serving.

recommendation.title: Support inferred prefixes
recommendation.body: Treat route-prefix hard refreshes such as `/openclaw/skills/workshop` and legacy nested URLs as supported, then land a narrow allowlisted public-asset fix.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent gateway static-asset ownership makes this the best available routing owner for the URL/static-serving contract choice.
